planner: US (JCS Joint Advanced Study Committee, reported via Adm. Radford)
name_source: the Vietminh in the Dien Bien Phu area
source_doc: FRUS 1952-54 vol. XIII Indochina, doc. 711: Memorandum by the Counselor (MacArthur) to the Secretary of State, 7 Apr 1954; https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1952-54v13p1/d711
quote: estimate of whether atomic weapons could be used to clean up the Vietminh in the Dien Bien Phu area. It has reached the conclusion that three tactical A-weapons, properly employed, would be sufficient
notes: The editors footnote Nixon's memoir calling this "Operation Vulture" (three small tactical atomic bombs). Feasibility estimate; not approved.
